subject: Discovery recap + scope: tracing hooks, golden prompts, rollout guardrails
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reid <alex.reid@financecloud.io>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@financecloud.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + scope: tracing hooks, golden prompts, rollout guardrails

Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track scope:

Pain points you described
- Silent regressions when models are reloaded or when prompts drift; manual experiments take weeks to reproduce.
- Limited observability into per-prompt latency/cost; engineering can’t attribute recent token-cost spikes.
- Need controlled rollouts for model updates (canary + automatic rollback) and tighter QA before production.

Current stack you shared
- Serving: in-house inference fronted by Seldon (K8s)
- Metrics/observability: Prometheus + Grafana for infra; Kibana for logs
- Evaluation: ad-hoc Jupyter notebooks + a small golden prompt set maintained in repo

Success criteria (what FinanceCloud wants within the pilot)
- Regression detection: alert on 5%+ degradation on golden set metrics within 24h of rollout
- Traceability: request-level trace id that links generated tokens -> prompting context -> latency/cost breakdown
- Dashboards: token-level cost, per-route latency p50/p95, golden-prompt performance over time
- SLOs: median latency < 150ms for internal routes; rollout must support step-based canaries and auto-fallback

What Redwood proposes for the pilot (high level)
- Instrumentation: lightweight tracing hook to emit a trace_id and token-cost breakdown (sampled) into your existing tracing pipeline; can forward to Jaeger/OpenTelemetry collector.
- Evals: canonical golden prompt set (you provided examples) + continuous regression alerts; nightly run with diff logs and a simple triage workflow.
- Dashboards: out-of-the-box Grafana dashboards for token-cost, per-prompt failure modes, and rollout status.
- Rollouts: A/B/canary support with automatic rollback rules tied to eval regressions.

Requested artifacts attached: requirements_matrix.xlsx (matrix of features, priority), redwood_sla.pdf (standard pilot SLAs).

Next steps (proposed)
1) Tech deep-dive (90m) with your infra/observability engineer — propose Tue 16 Mar or Wed 17 Mar.
2) Access: temporary dev cluster creds or an example request/trace payload to verify instrumentation (we don’t need production secrets).
3) Agreement on 6-week pilot success criteria and a simple mutual action plan.

Would you confirm preferred slot for the tech call and whether we should include your compliance lead (Samantha mentioned GDPR/data locality concerns)?

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood_sla.pdf
From: Alex Reid <alex.reid@financecloud.io>

Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 17:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + scope: tracing hooks, golden prompts, rollout guardrails

Thanks Mina — this is great, really useful to capture. A few clarifications / priorities from our side:

1) Priority order for the pilot: (a) tracing + token cost attribution, (b) continuous golden-set evals + alerts, (c) rollout guardrails. We want to prove observability before gating rollouts.
2) Timeline: target to start pilot instrumentation the week of Mar 22, 2–3 week initial instrumentation + nightly evals, then iterate.
3) Compliance: Samantha will confirm whether EU-hosted metrics are required for any exported traces (we default to US now).

We can do Tue Mar 16 at 10:00am PT for the tech deep-dive. Please add an invite with a calendar link.

Alex
Head of Platform Engineering | FinanceCloud
alex.reid@financecloud.io

Priya / Dev —

Alex confirmed Tue 16 Mar at 10:00am PT for the 90m deep-dive. Quick draft agenda and asks so we’re aligned before the call:

Draft agenda (90m)- 10m: intros + success criteria recap- 20m: current infra walkthrough (FinanceCloud engineer)- 25m: instrumentation design (tracing hook, sampling policy, payload examples)- 20m: evals pipeline (golden set automation, alerting thresholds, nightly runs)- 10m: rollout guardrails + rollback policy + action items

Pre-call asks- Dev: bring the sample trace schema we discussed last week and a minimal Rust/Python snippet to demonstrate the hook. We should be ready to show a live trace->Grafana example.
- Priya: draft the evals job definition and a simple alert playbook (what triggers a paged incident vs Slack alert).

Plan to have the skeleton Grafana dashboards ready after the call for the pilot workspace; we’ll reuse Alex’s Prometheus endpoints. Also attach the requirements_matrix.xlsx to the calendar invite.

I’ll send the calendar invite and include Alex / Samantha.

Mina

Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for the time. Calendar invite sent for Tue Mar 16, 10:00am PT (90m). In advance of the call, a couple quick items we’d like you to share if possible:
- A single example request payload (anonymized) and corresponding log line that includes the request id or any client-side trace id you already emit.
- A golden prompt file (even a small subset) that we can use to seed the nightly evals; we’ll keep it private to the pilot.
- Any data residency constraints (Samantha) — if EU-only for traces, please flag now so we include region configuration in the pilot scope.

We’ll demo a short tracer PoC and the evals run during the call, and we’ll follow up with the initial Grafana dashboards within 48 hours.

Looking forward,
